verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a single marketing line saying Dynamics 365 Sales lets you "automate business processes," which implies, but does not document, user-defined automation. Nothing describes rules, event triggers, or the actions they fire. The autonomous agents and AI alerts are vendor-defined behaviors, not user-defined rules, so they get no credit here. Missing for 10: documented rule or workflow definition, event-based trigger types, configurable actions, depth of the automation engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Build custom sales apps, automate business processes, and enrich seller experiences—all tailored to your unique business needs.
